// why: Type check for the mods, mirroring the jsconfig.json Herdr writes next to each mod.
The module declarations (gpui-kit.d.ts, herdr.d.ts) are written by Herdr and git-ignored:
run `herdr-app check git-graph/mods/git-graph` once on a machine with Herdr to create them.
strictNullChecks is off on purpose: a View assigns its state in init(), which TypeScript cannot see as definite assignment.
noImplicitAny is off because the mods are plain JS with no annotations: it would report ~190 untyped parameters and drown the real type errors.
